problem: Support operators need a bounded agent that classifies incoming support tickets, identifies missing customer or policy evidence, and drafts concise replies without making unsupported promises.
success_criteria: Every recommendation includes a source or missing-evidence disclosure.
Refund, legal, and account-access cases are escalated when policy evidence is insufficient.
Customer-facing replies stay concise and distinguish facts from assumptions.
hard_failures: expose raw ticket transcript or credentials
skip escalation for legal or account-access risk

output_preferences.evidence_style: bounded source refs and missing-evidence bullets

runtime_preferences: openclaw workspace scaffold for channel/runtime exploration
declared evidence first, live-success evidence before runtime promotion
